terms.canonical_expansion: me to the ML Productivity Goodput
terms.context: That work introduced me to the ML Productivity Goodput (MPG) metric, fleet-level heterogeneity at a scale I had not seen before, and the daily reality of failure as a statistical certainty rather than an exception. The gap between what practitioners knew and what was written down was enormous. The researchers who built these systems published individual results, but the connective tissue between those results, the principles that made them cohere into a discipline, existed only in the heads of the people doing the work. This book is an attempt to document that connective tissue.
